summary: 2 major, 2 minor, 2 info findings. Full detail in session record; key evidence lines listed here.

findings.title: Anon-key acceptance test will fail post-apply with 42501 permission denied for can_access
findings.evidence: Migration is SECURITY INVOKER (migrations/20260825_create_global_analytics_rpc.sql:56-58) with EXECUTE granted to anon (:167); test calls RPC with anon key (test-global-analytics-rpc.mjs:7,13). PUBLIC-scoped permissive policies calling can_access exist on employee_benefits (baseline:4297), employee_uniforms (baseline:4376), time_logs (baseline:4823), companies (baseline:4200), cost_centers (baseline:4241), departments (baseline:4823 area); can_access EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC/anon in migrations/20260814205158_restrict_internal_security_definer_functions.sql. PostgreSQL OR-combines permissive policies and checks function EXECUTE at executor init -> anon query errors before returning rows. The migration's DO-block deny policy on employee_uniforms (:10-30) does not prevent this (other tables' policies still reference can_access for anon). Fail-closed, no data leak. Fix options: (a) authenticate the test (LOGIN_BRUNO/PASS_BRUNO in .env, follow existing test-login.mjs pattern); (b) SECURITY DEFINER RPC with pinned search_path (baseline get_public_careres pattern baseline:455-457); (c) rescope PUBLIC can_access policies to TO authenticated (pattern of 20260818161500_employees_select_beneficios.sql). Smallest/safest: (a) — no production policy changes; RPC is a dashboard (authenticated) consumer.

findings.title: benefit_va bucket ILIKE '%VA%' double-counts VR and sweeps Vale Transporte
findings.evidence: Migrations/20260825_create_global_analytics_rpc.sql:72-73: vr bucket matches '%VALE REFEI%' or '%VR%'; va bucket matches '%CESTA%' or '%Alimenta%' or '%VA%'. Production benefit name 'VALE REFEIÇÃO' (confirmed src/app/dashboard/mps/page.tsx:108-110) contains 'VA' -> matched by BOTH buckets -> VR amounts double-counted into benefit_vr AND benefit_va; 'Vale Transporte' (src/lib/benefitClassification.ts:3) also mis-bucketed into va though design scopes buckets to Seguro/Odonto/VR/VA. Baseline get_employee_financials uses disjoint buckets with no '%VA%' (baseline:420-429). Fix: copy the baseline's disjoint bucket patterns.

findings.title: Ineffective DO-block policy employee_uniforms_no_anon with misleading comment; rollback note incomplete
findings.evidence: Migrations/20260825_create_global_analytics_rpc.sql:10-30 creates a deny policy claiming anon gets zero rows instead of an error — false (anon errors via other tables' PUBLIC policies first); rollback comment (:1) omits the policy. Fix: remove the DO block entirely (migration not yet applied, so removal is clean), keep rollback = DROP FUNCTION only.

findings.title: uniform_cost=0 deviation undocumented
findings.evidence: Migrations/20260825_create_global_analytics_rpc.sql:126 hardcodes 0::numeric AS uniform_cost; design doc asks for 'Custo do mês' but schema has no price column (employee_uniforms baseline:1824-1832; uniform_items baseline:2651-2657; no uniform_requests table). Fix: add a short comment documenting the deviation; keep uniform_count as the real datum.

findings.title: Weak test assertions
findings.evidence: test-global-analytics-rpc.mjs:28-33 passes on empty result ('Success, rows: 0'). Strengthen: assert data.length > 0 (production has employees) and that key columns (employee_id, name, base_salary, benefit_vr, benefit_va) exist on row 0.

findings.title: No p_month/p_year bounds validation
findings.evidence: MAKE_DATE raises for month 0/13/null -> fail-closed 500. Acceptable; note for Task 3/4 callers.

positive_tests: All referenced tables/columns verified against baseline with exact names/casing (employees baseline:1838-1888; companies :1643-1657; departments :1703-1707; cost_centers :1689-1697; employee_benefits :1745-1752; employee_uniforms :1824-1832; time_logs :2597-2607)
No employees->workplaces join -> known join-ambiguity bug class avoided (:148-154)
encargos formula byte-for-byte matches baseline get_employee_financials (:111-120 vs baseline:403)
Idempotent: policy guarded via pg_policies check, CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION, re-runnable ALTER OWNER/GRANTs
Additive; rollback is single DROP FUNCTION
No RLS-bypass leak to anon found (fail-closed)
Test loads .env not .env.local.txt; prints no credential values
remaining_risks: va/vr overlap would corrupt Tasks 3-4 totals if unfixed
Absence heuristic may count weekends/holidays as absences if logged as empty rows
Post-apply probes recommended: anon call expected 42501; authenticated call expected rows
